data.change_summary: All 5 shrimp scenario probes are fully implemented in crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs and passing. Each probe is a named test function with a doc-comment husbandry story: (1) probe_successful_breeding — 1200-hour run, 6/6 berried windows, population maintained with juveniles; (2) probe_thermal_suppression — 25°C vs 31°C comparison, warm readiness 0.002 vs cool 0.038, zero warm juveniles; (3) probe_chemistry_stress — low GH + 4 mg/L NO₂, 20→0 mortality, condition 0.7→0.0, elevated molt stress; (4) probe_chloride_protection — salt-treated tank 0 post-treatment deaths vs 3 control deaths, hazard 0.35 vs 4.37; (5) probe_crash_mode — 40 shrimp in 15L nano, 100% mortality in 30 days, TAN=77, NO₂=12.8. Diagnostics via shrimp_diag() dump per-stage counts, condition, molt stress, readiness, repro suppression, pH, GH, NO₂, Cl, DO, temp. enable_instrumentation() activates Detail/Trace-level tracing capturing per-tick pool deltas including animal.reserve_g. The all_shrimp_probes_summary test runs all 5 probes, produces a structured summary report with population outcomes, and exits non-zero on envelope violation. All assertions use directional comparisons and envelope ranges — no frozen exact counts.
outstanding_risks: No standalone shell script wrapper — e2e runner is the all_shrimp_probes_summary Rust test function invoked via cargo test; if a shell script is specifically required it would need to be added

Breeding probe population stabilizes at 10 rather than growing — mortality is disabled but condition declines to 0.016 and molt_stress reaches 1.0 by end, suggesting long-running colony health may need calibration tuning in a later pass
Chemistry stress probe results in 100% mortality (20→0) which is a strong signal but may be too aggressive for gameplay; calibration pass (tanksim-6e5.7.3) may want to tune stress mortality scale

steps.description: Verify 5 named test functions exist with doc-comment husbandry stories (probe_successful_breeding, probe_thermal_suppression, probe_chemistry_stress, probe_chloride_protection, probe_crash_mode)

Verify all_shrimp_probes_summary test runs all 5 scenarios, logs structured traces, produces summary report with population outcomes, and exits non-zero on envelope violation

Verify assertions use directional/envelope comparisons (not frozen exact counts) — population_maintained uses >=, mortality_occurred uses <, thermal uses directional comparison, chloride uses < between branches
Verify successful-breeding probe runs 1200 hours (>1000) and observes 6 berried-female windows (≥2 reproductive cycles)
Run full test suite: cargo test --test e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes — all 6 tests pass (5 individual probes + 1 summary)
